title: Psychologically Sound Tips for Better Sleep with Robin Haight, PsyD

sentences.en: We can't live without it.
sentences.zh: 我们离不开它。

sentences.en: Most of us don't get enough of it.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人睡眠不足。

sentences.en: And when we don't, we get cranky, less productive, and more prone to health probleMs. I'm talking about sleep, of course.
sentences.zh: 如果我们睡不够，就会变得脾气暴躁、效率低下，且更容易出现健康问题。当然，我指的是睡眠。

sentences.en: Hello and welcome to Speaking of Psychology, a biweekly podcast from the American Psychological
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎收听《心理学谈话》，这是美国心理学会推出的一档双周播客，

sentences.en: Association that explores the connections between psychological science and everyday life.
sentences.zh: 旨在探讨心理科学与日常生活之间的联系。

sentences.en: I'm your host, Caitlin Luna.
sentences.zh: 我是主持人凯特琳·卢纳。

sentences.en: Do you remember the last time you woke up during the work week without an alarm clock when you didn't need caffeine to get going?
sentences.zh: 你还记得上一次在工作日期间，没用闹钟就自然醒，而且不需要靠咖啡因来提神是什么时候吗？

sentences.en: If you can't, you're certainly not alone.
sentences.zh: 如果你记不起来了，那肯定不止你一个人这样。

sentences.en: Most of us fall short of the recommended seven to eight hours of sleep nightly, and an estimated 50 million to 70 million Americans of all ages
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人每晚的睡眠时间都达不到建议的七到八小时，据美国睡眠呼吸暂停协会估计，

sentences.en: and socioeconomic backgrounds suffer from sleep-related problems, according to the American Sleep Apnea
sentences.zh: 有5000万到7000万名各种年龄段和不同社会经济背景的美国人

sentences.en: Association.
sentences.zh: 正遭受睡眠相关问题的困扰。

sentences.en: Our guests for this episode will give practical tips for getting a good night's sleep and explain how common mental health disorders can interfere with our much-needed shut eye.
sentences.zh: 本期节目的嘉宾将分享获得优质睡眠的实用建议，并解释常见的心理健康障碍如何干扰我们急需的休息。

sentences.en: Dr. Robin Haight is a clinical psychologist in private practice in Virginia who specializes in treating anxiety, depression, and sleep issues.
sentences.zh: 罗宾·海特博士是一位在弗吉尼亚州私人执业的临床心理学家，专门治疗焦虑、抑郁和睡眠问题。

sentences.en: Welcome, Dr. Haight.
sentences.zh: 欢迎您，海特博士。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: We're very happy to have you on the show today.
sentences.zh: 很高兴您今天能来参加节目。

sentences.en: Can you explain some of the most common sleep issues you see with clients in your practice?
sentences.zh: 您能解释一下在您的诊疗中，最常见的睡眠问题有哪些吗？

sentences.en: By far, the most common complaint that I hear is that people have trouble falling asleep.
sentences.zh: 目前为止，我听到最常见的抱怨是人们难以入睡。

sentences.en: That's called sleep initiation.
sentences.zh: 这被称为入睡困难。

sentences.en: And most of the time, they're saying that they have racing thoughts or just not being able to shut off their brain.
sentences.zh: 大多数时候，他们说自己思绪万千，或者就是无法让大脑停下来。

sentences.en: So how do you address that?
sentences.zh: 那么您是如何解决这个问题的呢？

sentences.en: I mean, how do you shut off your brain when it's just going a million miles an hour?
sentences.zh: 我是说，当大脑以每小时一百万英里的速度运转时，你该如何让它停下来？

sentences.en: Do you get up?
sentences.zh: 你会起床吗？

sentences.en: Do you change positions, read a book, turn on the TV, start texting your friends?
sentences.zh: 你会换个姿势、看书、打开电视，还是开始给朋友发短信？

sentences.en: Well, let's back up maybe 30 minutes before all of this happens.
sentences.zh: 嗯，让我们把时间倒回到这一切发生前的30分钟。

sentences.en: Because a lot of times when I hear people talk about falling asleep, and I always ask about sleep when someone comes in to talk to me about anything.
sentences.zh: 因为很多时候，当我听到人们谈论入睡问题时——无论谁来找我谈论任何事情，我总是会问起睡眠情况。

sentences.en: I always ask, you know, how are you sleeping these days?
sentences.zh: 我总是会问，你知道，你最近睡得怎么样？

sentences.en: What I often find out is a lot of people have very poor sleep routines or sleep hygiene, we tend to call it, you know, preparing for sleep.
sentences.zh: 我经常发现，很多人有非常糟糕的睡眠习惯，或者我们称之为睡眠卫生，也就是为睡眠做准备。

sentences.en: Or they may have sort of different kinds of attitudes about sleep, such as thinking that sleep is optional, not integral to mental health, or physical health.
sentences.zh: 或者他们对睡眠持有不同的态度，比如认为睡眠是可有可无的，而不是心理健康或身体健康不可或缺的一部分。

sentences.en: And so I start to uncover some of these problems that happen even before they get into bed, in terms of their attitudes or their sleep hygiene.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始揭示一些在他们上床睡觉前就存在的问题，涉及他们的态度或睡眠卫生。

sentences.en: So what is good sleep hygiene?
sentences.zh: 那么什么是良好的睡眠卫生呢？

sentences.en: Well, again, we have to back up at least 30 minutes, preferably an hour before you really want to go to bed, or before you want to go to sleep, let's say.
sentences.zh: 嗯，同样，我们必须至少提前30分钟，最好是在你真正想上床睡觉，或者说想入睡前一小时。

sentences.en: And having a good routine that kind of helps you separate the day from from bedtime.
sentences.zh: 建立一个良好的日常习惯，帮助你把白天和睡前时间区分开来。

sentences.en: And that's doesn't include watching a scary movie and then turning it off and then expecting to go right to sleep.
sentences.zh: 这可不包括看完一部恐怖电影，然后关掉它，就指望能立刻入睡。

sentences.en: Yeah, right.
sentences.zh: 是啊，没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, things like that are going to really jazz you up are going to be overstimulating things that are going
sentences.zh: 你知道，像那样会让你非常兴奋、过度刺激的事情，

sentences.en: to kind of, you know, maybe having a an intense conversation with your partner with your kids, or, you know, things like that, really, you got to keep that stuff in mind.
sentences.zh: 或者比如与伴侣或孩子进行激烈的谈话，你知道，诸如此类的事情，你真的得把这些记在心上。

sentences.en: When you think about sleep, and you know, really being protective of your sleep.
sentences.zh: 当你考虑睡眠时，你知道，要真正保护好你的睡眠。

sentences.en: I hear a lot about not using a screen before bed.
sentences.zh: 我经常听到关于睡前不要使用电子屏幕的建议。

sentences.en: So, you know, putting your smartphone away, maybe even putting it in another room might be helpful.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，把智能手机收起来，甚至把它放在另一个房间可能会有帮助。

sentences.en: So do you tell people to really minimize screen time as you approach that hour before you go to sleep?
sentences.zh: 那么，您是否建议人们在临睡前的那一小时里尽量减少看屏幕的时间？

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I mean, this is now, you know, five years ago, I was sort of informing people about this.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这在现在，你知道，五年前我还在向人们普及这个知识。

sentences.en: Now people seem to know that screens, you know, and now you can buy blue light filtering glasses.
sentences.zh: 现在人们似乎都知道屏幕，而且现在你可以买到防蓝光眼镜。

sentences.en: So people can still be on their phones right before bed, because they think that if they just filter out the blue light, that that's good enough.
sentences.zh: 所以人们仍然可以在睡前玩手机，因为他们认为只要过滤掉蓝光就足够了。

sentences.en: But I really do try to get people to get off their screens a good 30 to 60 minutes before going to bed.
sentences.zh: 但我确实尽量让人们在睡前30到60分钟远离屏幕。

sentences.en: But the problem is a lot of people use their phones for their alarm clock.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，很多人用手机当闹钟。

sentences.en: So it's probably not realistic to say, leave your phone in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 所以说把手机留在厨房可能不太现实。

sentences.en: But you know, sometimes it's just reminding people, like, get off your phone, don't
sentences.zh: 但你知道，有时只是提醒人们，比如，放下手机，不要

sentences.en: watch videos on your phone until you until right before bed, or don't watch TV shows on your computer
sentences.zh: 一直盯着手机看视频直到睡前，或者不要在睡前用电脑

sentences.en: on your laptop right before going to bed, because those kinds of things really do suppress the melatonin that you that your brain produces to help you feel start to feel sleepy.
sentences.zh: 用笔记本电脑看电视节目，因为这些事情确实会抑制大脑产生的褪黑素，而褪黑素能帮助你开始感到困倦。

sentences.en: So it really is important to not have any close screen devices right before going to bed.
sentences.zh: 所以睡前不使用任何近距离屏幕设备确实很重要。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And you said it can be difficult as you, you know, if you do use it for your alarm clock,
sentences.zh: 您刚才说这可能会很困难，因为如果您确实用它当闹钟，

sentences.en: if it's the only clock in your in your room, you might be thinking, Oh, I have that last text message I need to send before I go to bed.
sentences.zh: 如果它是你房间里唯一的时钟，你可能会想，哦，我还有最后一条短信要在睡前发出去。

sentences.en: But as much as you can just just try not to have your phone.
sentences.zh: 但尽可能地，尽量不要带手机。

sentences.en: Yeah, just as much as you can.
sentences.zh: 是的，尽你所能。

sentences.en: I mean, I even look at my phone right before I go to bed sometimes that I think I know I shouldn't be doing this.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我有时在睡前也会看手机，我想我知道我不该这么做。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's hard.
sentences.zh: 是啊，这很难。

sentences.en: It's hard.
sentences.zh: 很难。

sentences.en: But I want to check out this Instagram feed, you know?
sentences.zh: 但我就是想刷一下Instagram，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, right.
sentences.zh: 是啊，没错。

sentences.en: I mean, just like I think of things as you're about to go to bed for the night.
sentences.zh: 我是说，就像你在准备睡觉时想到的那些事情一样。

sentences.en: So you talk about how you when you're you see your clients, no matter what they come in, you ask about sleep.
sentences.zh: 您提到无论客户因何而来，您都会询问他们的睡眠情况。

sentences.en: So can you talk about the mental health benefits of sleep?
sentences.zh: 那么您能谈谈睡眠对心理健康的好处吗？

sentences.en: Sleep is still not entirely understood and why we need sleep.
sentences.zh: 人们对睡眠以及我们为什么需要睡眠仍然没有完全了解。

sentences.en: I mean, it's been studied for a long, long time.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它已经被研究了很长很长一段时间了。

sentences.en: And those then the research is ongoing.
sentences.zh: 而且研究仍在继续。

sentences.en: But what we have seen in some recent research is how sleep helps us build up long term memories and helps us
sentences.zh: 但我们在最近的一些研究中看到，睡眠如何帮助我们建立长期记忆，并帮助我们

sentences.en: sort of consolidate our learning during the day, or to process what we've been through during the day.
sentences.zh: 整理白天的学习内容，或者处理我们白天经历的事情。

sentences.en: It also helps us build cognitive and emotional reserves.
sentences.zh: 它还能帮助我们建立认知和情感储备。

sentences.en: We also know that if you don't sleep, you have a lot of physical problems, too.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道，如果你不睡觉，也会有很多身体问题。

sentences.en: Like there's been there was this research, a study done where animals that were deprived of entirely deprived entirely of sleep,
sentences.zh: 比如曾经有一项研究，对完全被剥夺睡眠的动物进行实验，

sentences.en: lost all immune function, and they died within a matter of weeks.
sentences.zh: 它们失去了所有的免疫功能，并在几周内死亡。

sentences.en: Now, we couldn't necessarily deprive a human of sleep entirely to cause them to go, you know, to lose all of their immune function.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们不能为了让一个人失去所有免疫功能而完全剥夺他们的睡眠。

sentences.en: But sleep is such an important thing for learning, for keeping emotional regulation.
sentences.zh: 但睡眠对于学习、保持情绪调节确实非常重要。

sentences.en: And all of us know how if we go to bed, and we're in a bad mood, we're thinking about something that's upsetting some if we have a good
sentences.zh: 我们都知道，如果我们上床时心情不好，在想一些令人沮丧的事情，如果能睡个好觉，

sentences.en: night's sleep, it may not be that is that upsetting the next day.
sentences.zh: 第二天可能就不会那么沮丧了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I definitely do feel like that you also feel kind of like you have a clean slate when you wake up in the
sentences.zh: 是的，我确实有这种感觉，你也会觉得早上醒来时有一种焕然一新的感觉，

sentences.en: morning, if you've if you slept well, of course, if that whatever was bothering you didn't keep you up in the night,
sentences.zh: 当然，如果你睡得好，前提是那些困扰你的事情没有让你彻夜难眠的话。

sentences.en: I notice a physical feeling, which is I'm sure many people do as well.
sentences.zh: 我注意到一种身体上的感觉，我相信很多人也有同感。

sentences.en: Like you just feel better in the morning, knowing your your brain just, like you said, consolidate your memories kind of process what you went through during the
sentences.zh: 就像你早上感觉更好，因为你知道你的大脑，就像你说的，整理了你的记忆，处理了你白天经历的事情，

sentences.en: day, and you feel more refreshed.
sentences.zh: 你会感到更加神清气爽。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, it's, it's kind of mysterious, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊，这有点神秘，不是吗？

sentences.en: You know, in eight hours, you could have a completely different perspective.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在八小时内，你可能会有完全不同的视角。

sentences.en: And sometimes a good night's sleep even helps you think of alternatives to problems that you didn't even you weren't even able to see the night before.
sentences.zh: 有时睡个好觉甚至能帮你想到前一天晚上根本无法看到的解决问题的替代方案。

sentences.en: I don't want to be like, oh, just get a good night's sleep and all your problems will be solved.
sentences.zh: 我不想说，哦，只要睡个好觉，你所有的问题都会迎刃而解。

sentences.en: But, you know, sleeping does help with giving us the energy and the just sort of this emotional space to allow for other options to enter our minds.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，睡眠确实有助于给我们提供能量，并提供一种情感空间，让其他选择进入我们的脑海。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And on that note, I did an episode in January of 2019 about dreaming.
sentences.zh: 说到这里，我在2019年1月做过一期关于梦的节目。

sentences.en: So we're just very focused on dreaming.
sentences.zh: 我们当时非常关注梦。

sentences.en: And the psychologist I interviewed, Dr. Deirdre Barrett, she talked about how, you know, people say, how can I remember my dreams more?
sentences.zh: 我采访的心理学家迪尔德丽·巴雷特博士谈到，你知道，人们问，我怎样才能记住更多的梦？

sentences.en: And she said, what I tell them is just to get more sleep.
sentences.zh: 她说，我告诉他们的方法就是多睡觉。

sentences.en: If you want to remember dreams, you have to get more sleep, you allow your brain to get into REM, to get into the really deep sleep.
sentences.zh: 如果你想记住梦，你必须多睡觉，让你的大脑进入快速眼动期，进入深度睡眠。

sentences.en: And so that's talked about the importance of that in terms of being able to remember your dreams and, you know, take advantage of what they might be trying to tell you.
sentences.zh: 所以我们讨论了这对于记住梦的重要性，以及，你知道，利用它们可能试图告诉你的信息。

sentences.en: Given how you are, you treat a lot of clients or an expert on anxiety and depression.
sentences.zh: 鉴于您治疗过很多客户，并且是焦虑和抑郁方面的专家。

sentences.en: Can you talk about the relationship between depression and sleep and anxiety and sleep?
sentences.zh: 您能谈谈抑郁与睡眠、焦虑与睡眠之间的关系吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: You know, there's actually a lot of overlap in the symptoms between insomnia and the symptoms
sentences.zh: 你知道，失眠的症状与抑郁或焦虑的症状之间实际上有很多重叠，

sentences.en: of depression or anxiety, like fatigue being one, obviously, that's an obvious one, but loss of
sentences.zh: 比如疲劳就是一个明显的例子，当然，但对通常感兴趣的事物失去兴趣、

sentences.en: interest in stuff you're normally, you know, interested in, worrying, poor concentration, loss of motivation, even kind of suicidal thoughts or thoughts of like, I can't go on.
sentences.zh: 担忧、注意力不集中、缺乏动力，甚至产生自杀念头或觉得我无法继续下去的想法。

sentences.en: Those symptoms can appear in both insomnia and depression or anxiety.
sentences.zh: 这些症状可能同时出现在失眠、抑郁或焦虑中。

sentences.en: And in fact, 80% of people with depression report problems with sleep.
sentences.zh: 事实上，80%的抑郁症患者报告有睡眠问题。

sentences.en: So it's really important to tease out whether it's we're dealing with insomnia or if we're dealing with some sort of depressive episode.
sentences.zh: 所以，弄清楚我们面对的是失眠，还是某种抑郁发作，这一点非常重要。

sentences.en: So what do you recommend if you are experiencing insomnia?
sentences.zh: 那么如果您正在经历失眠，您有什么建议？

sentences.en: Do you recommend that someone go see their primary care physician?
sentences.zh: 您建议人们去看初级保健医生吗？

sentences.en: Should they seek out mental health services?
sentences.zh: 他们应该寻求心理健康服务吗？

sentences.en: You know, most people wait months or even years of having poor sleep before they even seek help.
sentences.zh: 你知道，大多数人在寻求帮助之前，已经忍受了几个月甚至几年的睡眠质量差。

sentences.en: They just learn to live with it or they tell themselves, you probably have heard people say,
sentences.zh: 他们只是学会了忍受，或者他们告诉自己，你可能听过人们说，

sentences.en: I'm not a good sleeper.
sentences.zh: 我睡眠不好。

sentences.en: And they think that that's an okay thing to say.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这样说没问题。

sentences.en: So they have this narrative that they just sort of live with like, yeah, you know, I'm, I toss and turn or my, my partner says
sentences.zh: 所以他们有这样一种叙述，他们只是忍受着，比如，是的，你知道，我辗转反侧，或者我的伴侣说

sentences.en: that I wake up a lot at night and, and they just live with it.
sentences.zh: 我晚上醒来很多次，他们就这么忍着。

sentences.en: So after folks have really decided that they want to address their insomnia, which for many people can take months or years for them to get to
sentences.zh: 所以，在人们真正决定要解决失眠问题后——对许多人来说，达到这一点可能需要几个月甚至几年——我总是先问，你知道，你有多久没看医生了，或者你看过医生了吗？

sentences.en: that point, I always start with, you know, how long has it been since you've seen your doctor or have you seen your doc?
sentences.zh: 你告诉过你的医生这件事吗？

sentences.en: Have you told your doctor about this?
sentences.zh: 因为我一定要让他们的医生排除任何医疗问题。

sentences.en: Because I definitely want their physician to rule out any medical issues there.
sentences.zh: 确实可能存在一些医疗问题，或者药物会影响你的睡眠。

sentences.en: And there can be some medical issues or medications can affect how you're sleeping.
sentences.zh: 有些抗组胺药会影响睡眠。

sentences.en: There are antihistamines that can affect your sleeping.
sentences.zh: 有些人正在服用

sentences.en: Some people are taking
sentences.zh: 抗抑郁药，这也会影响睡眠。

sentences.en: antidepressants and that can affect their sleeping.
sentences.zh: 哮喘药、类固醇，这些都会影响睡眠。

sentences.en: Asthma medicine, steroids, these things all can affect sleeping.
sentences.zh: 并不是说你不应该服用这些药物。

sentences.en: And it's not that you shouldn't take any of those drugs.
sentences.zh: 只是，也许你只需要调整一下服药时间。

sentences.en: It's just, maybe you just need to tinker with when you take them.
sentences.zh: 所以我一定要先把医疗方面的问题理顺，这样我们才能开始讨论他们对睡眠的信念和态度，以及他们的

sentences.en: So I definitely want the medical side of things to be kind of in order so that we can start talking about their beliefs and their attitudes about sleeping and their
sentences.zh: 做法，你知道，他们的睡眠卫生，他们为睡眠所做的准备。

sentences.en: practice, you know, their, their sleep hygiene, their preparation for sleep.
